conventions.propagator_scalar_factor: D_eps(r) = (1-exp(-r^2/4eps))/(4 pi^2 r^2) = int_eps^inf (4 pi t)^-2 exp(-r^2/4t) dt ; momentum exp(-eps p^2)/p^2

evaluation_strategy: dimensional analysis: every subtracted graph is |x|^{-w1-w2} times a function of |x|^2/eps plus log eps from counterterms
Lemma lem:t-ft: only the log^2 and log coefficients of the momentum-space small-eps|q|^2 expansion survive at x != 0; constants (e.g. 6 zeta(3) of the kite) are contact terms
Lemma lem:t-reduce: numerators reduced exactly by p^2 Dhat(p) = exp(-eps p^2)
Lemma lem:t-local: replacing a subgraph by a smeared one changes the result by a one-dimensional Gaussian integral (log(2/3)/(16 pi^2) for the bubble)
bubble masters: Step 1 closed forms with gamma_E and log 2
expected constants: rationals, gamma_E, log 2, log 3; zeta(3) only in contact terms
large_distance: Lemma lem:t-ir: integrand ~ R^{-4|S| - sigma}, sigma = sum of Weyl weights of far ends of edges leaving S; sigma > 0 unless all leave to ghosts c; holds for every graph listed
